column1: # Generated by tools/recovery_crosscheck.py from jetsetradio.exe, data/functions.json.gz (18102 entries) and Ghidra 12.2's 10994 functions. Do not edit: rerun scripts/ghidra_crosscheck.sh.
# The columns and how to rebuild it are in the script's docstring.
# alias         eh-funclet               287  a C++ EH funclet (an unwind action or a catch block): by design an entry of the function that installs it, where Ghidra makes each one a function
# alias         label-in-body              3  a label inside the parent, which runs through it. Ghidra starts a function at the label
# alias-outside alias-of-ours-only        37  an entry of a function of ours that Ghidra doesn't have (that function's own row says why)
# alias-outside beyond-ghidra-end          3  an entry in the part of the parent's body past where Ghidra ends that function; Ghidra decoded nothing here

# alias-outside eh-stub                  127  a C++ EH handler stub placed after its function, which its prologue pushes: by design an entry of that function. Ghidra decodes it but makes no function of it
# alias-outside other-owner               24  Ghidra holds it in another function's body, outside that function's range; we hold it in the parent's
# invented      called-by-ours-only       16  called only by functions Ghidra doesn't have either (their own rows say why)

# invented      data-as-code              14  Ghidra has data here (a switch table, a constant), which we decoded because a 4-byte value or an E8 or E9 byte elsewhere names it. Nothing decoded calls it, so nothing runs it
# invented      data-ptr-only             31  named only by a 4-byte value in data where Ghidra made no reference; it decodes as code, and nothing decoded calls it
# invented      ilt-data                 839  an ILT stub whose address is stored in data (a vtable or a callback table). Ghidra decoded it but made no function of it
# invented      ilt-jump                   4  an ILT stub reached by a jump. Ghidra decoded it but made no function of it
# invented      ilt-target-no-function   117  reached through an ILT stub that data points at. Ghidra decoded it from there but made no function of it
# invented      ilt-target-unreached     378  reached through ILT stubs that nothing reaches: code the linker kept and the program never calls
# invented      ilt-unseen-pointer        15  an ILT stub named only by a 4-byte value (in data or code) or an E8 or E9 byte, where Ghidra made no reference; Ghidra never decoded it
# invented      ilt-unused              1200  an ILT stub that nothing calls, jumps to or points at. Ghidra decodes only the stubs it reaches; the lift keeps every slot
# invented      pointer-no-function      150  its address is an immediate in code (a callback pushed or stored) or a value in data. Ghidra records the reference but made no function there
# invented      prologue-only              2  found only by its push ebp; mov ebp, esp: code that nothing calls, jumps to or points at
# invented      rel32-only                17  found only by an E8 or E9 byte the linear scan read as a call or a jump; nothing decoded calls it, so nothing runs it
# invented      seh-funclet               55  an SEH filter, __except block or __finally block in the C runtime, named by its scope table. Ghidra decodes none of them

# missing       eh-funclet-no-entry        1  a C++ catch block inside another function's body, named only by its EH table, with no entry of its own: a throw that reaches it would find no lifted funclet
# missing       label-in-body              3  a label inside the parent, which runs through it. Ghidra starts a function at the label
# missing       unreferenced               4  nothing calls, jumps to or points at it, and no ILT stub names it, so nothing can reach it. Ghidra found it by its shape
# split         data-ptr-only              1  named only by a 4-byte value in data where Ghidra made no reference; it decodes as code, and nothing decoded calls it

# split         false-start-data-ptr      61  a 4-byte value in data equals the address of an instruction inside Ghidra's function, and the data scan took it. The lifted function before it runs through it, so nothing is lost; it is no function, and the map must not name it as one
# split         false-start-prologue       1  a push ebp; mov ebp, esp at an instruction inside Ghidra's function, where Ghidra has no reference to it. The lifted function before it runs through it

# split         false-start-rel32          4  an E8 or E9 byte elsewhere reads as a call or jump to an instruction inside Ghidra's function, where Ghidra has no reference: a coincidence of the linear scan. The lifted function before it runs through it

# split         false-start-selfcall       8  an E8 byte inside one of Ghidra's instructions reads as a call to itself, which kept it. Nothing else reaches it, and the lifted function around it runs through the real instructions
# split         ilt-target-unreached       1  reached through ILT stubs that nothing reaches: code the linker kept and the program never calls

# split         jump-label                94  a label inside Ghidra's function that only an unconditional jump reaches, after a ret, jmp or call. disasm32 keeps such a target as a start on purpose, since a tail call looks the same. The lifted function before it runs through it
# split         seh-funclet               22  an SEH filter, __except block or __finally block in the C runtime, named by its scope table. Ghidra decodes none of them
